targets.claim: Kogilicious is located at 956 Embarcadero Del Norte in Isla Vista, California.
Kogilicious is a Korean cuisine restaurant.
The restaurant is open every day from 10:00 AM to 11:00 PM.
The restaurant does not offer WiFi.
The restaurant does not offer validated parking.
The restaurant is good for groups.
The restaurant has a casual ambience.
The restaurant has a 4-star average rating.
The half and half beef ribs and pork are described as the best some customers have ever had.
The Kogilicious spicy chicken burrito is a crowd favorite.
Beef, spicy pork, and tofu are available protein options.
Customers have praised the restaurant for its reasonable prices, especially when paying cash.
Using a card may attract additional charges.
